_doc: THE KNOWN CONSUMER (v1: one). Copy this file to known-consumer.json beside it (git-ignored) on the machine that builds the store binary; the csproj embeds known-consumer.json when it exists and the build then offers 'Add a service' for this consumer. Without it the app carries no consumer and says so. base_url is the consumer's https origin; aud is the audience the pairing JWS names (the consumer verifies it); app_id is its brand folder id (/_content/<app_name>.Shared/brand/<app_id>-logo-1024.png); app_name and app_description render on the card.
